items.label: World X
items.tip: Across the plane x = 0

items.label: Topology
items.tip: Across the scalp's own surface: its left and right vertices matched once, whatever its pose

flowSink.label: Place
flowSink.tip: What a click or drag lays: arrows, or a sink (brush-sized) hair turns around

items.label: Arrows
items.tip: Drag to lay arrows; drag over arrows to comb them

items.label: Whorl
items.tip: Hair spirals out counter-clockwise around the click (a crown)

items.label: Whorl (clockwise)
items.tip: Hair spirals out clockwise around the click

items.label: Gather
items.tip: Hair points in toward the click

items.label: Part out
items.tip: Hair points away from the click (a cowlick)

sculptDisplay.label: Strands
sculptDisplay.tip: How strands draw while a stroke is live (they also drop to a lighter density unless Full density is on)

items.label: Width
items.tip: Grow the tubes near the brush (Ctrl: shrink them)

items.label: Flatness
items.tip: Flatten the tubes near the brush toward a ribbon (Ctrl: round them back)

items.label: Twist
items.tip: Turn the tubes near the brush about their guides (Ctrl: the other way)

items.label: Round
items.tip: A round tube: hair in a disc round the guide

items.label: Ribbon
items.tip: A rounded rectangle: a flat ribbon of hair once Flatness flattens it

items.label: Teardrop
items.tip: Round on top, pointed toward the scalp: a lock tapering to an edge underneath

items.label: Blade
items.tip: A lens pointed at both sides: a sharp, cartoon lock

tubeSmooth.tip: What Smooth evens out: the channel the brush paints (Width, Flatness or Twist), or all three

featherSource.label: Feathers
featherSource.tip: Where the feathers grow: scattered over the scalp, or one on each guide of a guide group

items.label: Scattered feathers (shaped by the guides)
items.tip: Feathers scattered over the scalp, laid the way the guides are combed: a body of contour or down feathers

items.label: One feather per guide (hand-placed)
items.tip: Each guide of the guide group is one feather, left out of the hair: draw or brush them one by one (flight feathers, a tail)

items.label: On the guides
items.tip: A layer on the guides: children inherit it, strands blend it from their guides, it survives a new scalp. Paint over the guides. As fine as the guides are.

items.label: On the scalp's vertices
items.tip: A value per vertex of the scalp mesh, kept with the groom in the scene. Paint over the scalp. As fine as the mesh is.

items.label: A texture
items.convert: A texture at the scalp's UVs...
items.tip: An image at the scalp's UVs (needs UVs), a PNG in the scene's groomlab/<scene>/masks folder: the finest detail, editable in any image editor, exportable. Paint over the scalp.

items.label: Gray (one value)
items.tip: One value, 0-1: a mask any param reads through a Map node.

items.label: Color (r g b a)
items.tip: Red, green, blue and alpha: painted hair color (a HairColor node's map), regions each strand's guides stay within (an Interpolate's regionMap: a color per region), or up to four masks packed in one map (a Map node reads each channel). On the scalp's vertices or a texture; guide layers are gray.

scalpChannel.label: Channel
scalpChannel.tip: What of a color map the scalp shows: its color, or one channel black to white

items.label: RGB
items.tip: Its color

items.label: R
items.tip: Paint, smooth and fill change red (untick the others to paint one mask packed in a channel)

items.label: G
items.tip: Paint, smooth and fill change green (untick the others to paint one mask packed in a channel)

items.label: B
items.tip: Paint, smooth and fill change blue (untick the others to paint one mask packed in a channel)

items.label: A
items.tip: Paint, smooth and fill change alpha (untick the others to paint one mask packed in a channel)

paintMode.label: Mode
paintMode.tip: How Paint and Fill combine the chosen value or color with the map

items.label: Replace
items.tip: Move existing values toward the chosen value (the original behavior)

items.label: Add
items.tip: Add the chosen value to existing values, clamped to 1

items.label: Subtract
items.tip: Subtract the chosen value from existing values, clamped to 0

items.label: Clamp Maximum
items.tip: Lower values above the chosen maximum and leave lower values unchanged

items.label: In front
items.tip: The photo draws over the mesh (see the mesh through it)

items.label: Behind
items.tip: The mesh draws over the photo

strandColor.label: Strand Colors
strandColor.tip: What the strands show in the viewport (renders keep the hair's material)

items.label: Solid
items.tip: The hair's own color

items.label: Color set
items.tip: A color set (map) of the scalp, at each root

items.label: Attribute
items.tip: A strand channel of the graph, black to white over Min to Max

items.label: Random
items.tip: A color per strand

items.label: Clump
items.tip: A color per clump

items.label: Density
items.tip: Strands per area: a heatmap

items.label: Always
items.tip: In the viewport and in renders

items.label: Viewport Only
items.tip: Renders, exports, the Arnold procedural and the CLI skip it: a fast stand-in

items.label: Render Only
items.tip: The viewport skips it: a heavy node kept for the final strands
